name: 31 (Scat)
description: 31 (Scat) is a knock game. Get 31 points in one suit (A=11, face=10, number=face value) or highest three-card hand. Draw one, discard one. Knock when confident; lowest hand loses a life. Blitz: 31 in three cards declared immediately; others lose a life. Last player with lives wins.
origin: Likely Italian in origin; spread through France and Britain and now popular in the USA and Britain.

history.origins: Probably descended from the 15th-century Italian gambling game trente et un; later popular in France, England and Ireland. The modern 31 / Scat variant is widely played in America and Britain under names like Blitz, Cadillac and Ride the Bus.
timeline: 15th century: Thirty-one (trente et un) first recorded in a sermon attributed to Saint Bernardino, likely of Italian origin.
16th–17th centuries: Spreads across Europe and becomes popular in France, England and Ireland.
Modern era: Casual gambling variant 31 / Scat becomes widely played in North America and Britain under regional names.

setup.deck: Standard 52-card deck. Aces count 11, court cards 10, other cards face value. Dutch variant (Eenendertigen) uses a 32-card pack (7 and above).
setup.dealing: 3 cards each; one card up for discard; rest stock.

rules.objective: Highest three-card hand (same suit total or high card). Avoid lowest when someone knocks.
rules.gameplay: Draw one from stock or discard, discard one. Knock: tap; others get one turn; show hands. Lowest loses one life; knocker lowest loses two. Blitz (31 in three): show at once; others lose a life.
keyRules: Knock then reveal; lowest loses life

strategy.intermediate: Track discards; knock when you have 25+ in a suit or high cards and others likely have less.
strategy.advanced: Blitz (31 in three) ends round; knock early to limit draws.
tips: Lowest hand when someone knocks loses a life; knocker lowest loses two.

variations.name: California Quick
variations.description: Fast-running home game variant where ties for lowest hand during a knock can cost the knocker two lives, and an opening knock on the first turn ('knocking out of the gate') ends the round immediately.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant is rule-only; engine-level parameter changes have not been modelled yet.

variations.name: Banking
variations.description: Banked version where everyone antes to a central pot and a special three-card widow can be exchanged with; highest hand or blitz (exact 31) wins the pot instead of simply losing lives.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Banking play changes betting flow but does not yet have explicit engine overrides configured.

variations.name: Dollar bill
variations.description: American scoring variant where each player tracks lives by folding the corners of a banknote; losing a life folds a corner and the last player with an unfolded bill wins the stake.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Dollar-bill scoring is captured in rules text; no separate engine overrides are wired for this variant yet.

scoring.winCondition: Highest three-card hand (same suit total or high card). Avoid lowest when someone knocks.
